const int maxn = 50*100+15;
int source = maxn-1;
int sink = maxn-2;
struct Edge {
    int u, v;
    ll cap, flow, cost;
    ll rem() { return cap - flow; }
};
int nodes = maxn;

vector<Edge> e;

    g[u].push_back(e.size());
    e.push_back({u, v, cap, 0, cost});
    g[v].push_back(e.size());
    e.push_back({v, u, 0, 0, -cost});
}
ll dist[maxn];
int pre[maxn];
ll bottleneck[maxn];
bool inq[maxn];
ll mncost, mxflow;

    mxflow = mncost = 0;
    while (true) {
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) dist[i] = INFCOST;
        dist[s] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) pre[i] = -1;
        pre[s] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) bottleneck[i] = 0;
        bottleneck[s] = INFFLOW;
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) inq[i] = false;
        int q[maxn];
        int qh = 0, qt = 0;
        q[qt++] = s;
        inq[s] = true;

            int u = q[qh++];

            inq[u] = false;

                        q[qt++] = E.v;
                        if (qt == maxn) qt = 0;
                        inq[E.v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (pre[t] < 0) break;
        mxflow += bottleneck[t];
        mncost += bottleneck[t] * dist[t];
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = e[pre[v]].u) {
            e[pre[v]].flow += bottleneck[t];
            e[pre[v]^1].flow -= bottleneck[t];
        }
    }
}

using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1e14;
struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    ll cap, cost;
};
class MinCostFlow {
public:
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<ll> pot, dist;
    vector<int> prevv, preve;
    MinCostFlow(int n) : n(n), g(n), pot(n, 0), dist(n), prevv(n), preve(n) {}
    void add_edge(int from, int to, ll cap, ll cost) {
        g[from].push_back({to, (int)g[to].size(), cap, cost});
        g[to].push_back({from, (int)g[from].size()-1, 0, -cost});
    }
    ll flow(int s, int t) {
        ll flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (true) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            priority_queue<pair<ll,int>, vector<pair<ll,int>>, greater<pair<ll,int>>> pq;
            pq.push({0, s});
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                int v = p.second;
                if (dist[v] < p.first) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[v].size(); i++) {
                    Edge &e = g[v][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0) {
                        ll nd = dist[v] + e.cost + pot[v] - pot[e.to];
                        if (dist[e.to] > nd) {
                            dist[e.to] = nd;
                            prevv[e.to] = v;
                            preve[e.to] = i;
                            pq.push({nd, e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                if (dist[v] < INF) pot[v] += dist[v];
            }
            ll d = INF;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                d = min(d, g[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            }
            flow += d;
            cost += d * pot[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge &e = g[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= d;
                g[v][e.rev].cap += d;
            }
        }
        return cost;
    }
};
int main() {

    cin.tie(0);
    ll n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int MAXT = n + k;
    int nodes = n * MAXT + 2;
    int SRC = nodes - 2;
    int SNK = nodes - 1;
    MinCostFlow mcf(nodes);
    vector<int> a(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        a[i]--;
        mcf.add_edge(SRC, a[i]*MAXT, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int j = 0; j < MAXT; j++) {
        mcf.add_edge(j, SNK, k, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        x--; y--;
        for (int j = 0; j < MAXT-1; j++) {
            for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                mcf.add_edge(x*MAXT+j, y*MAXT+j+1, 1, c + d*(2*K-1));
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < MAXT-1; j++) {
            for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                mcf.add_edge(y*MAXT+j, x*MAXT+j+1, 1, c + d*(2*K-1));
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < MAXT-1; j++) {
            for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                mcf.add_edge(i*MAXT+j, i*MAXT+j+1, 1, c);
            }
        }
    }
    ll mncost = mcf.flow(SRC, SNK);
